name: Toronto Public Library free online courses (LinkedIn Learning, IT skills)
summary: With a free Toronto Public Library card you can take online courses (LinkedIn Learning, Let's Learn Tech IT training, Brainfuse workplace tech skills, Gale Courses) at no cost.
whatYouDo: You sign in with your library card and work through self-paced video courses or instructor-led online classes on office software, IT support, programming, data analytics and job-search skills. It builds skills for your resume; it does not place you in a job.
appeal: Self-paced and flexible; learn from home
LinkedIn Learning (16,000+ courses per a TPL blog) includes resume and job-search topics
Let's Learn Tech covers IT skills such as cybersecurity, Python, data analytics, AI and networking
Brainfuse pathway covers word processing, spreadsheets, presentations and video-call tools
watchOuts: Toronto-focused: requires a TPL card (card eligibility not verified here); other Ontario libraries may offer similar services
Training only: no pay, placement or guaranteed credential
Course line-ups change; confirm on the eLearning page
Self-paced study needs your own motivation and a device with internet
applicationSteps: Get a Toronto Public Library card
Open TPL's eLearning page and choose a service (e.g., LinkedIn Learning, Let's Learn Tech)
Sign in with your library card and start a course
Add new skills to your resume and pair with job-search help (e.g., Employment Ontario)
fitsIf: You live in Toronto and want free, flexible, self-paced courses to build office, IT or job-search skills.
notFitIf: You need income now or want structured training with job placement.
